categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the tourism hotel industry and commercial building leasing. It provides lodging, dining, social, and conference facilities for travelers, along with commercial space rental. The main revenue streams include rental income, room income, dining services, and other related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on service quality improvement through regular maintenance and upgrades of facilities, incorporating customer and employee feedback. It employs energy-saving technologies such as microcomputer temperature controllers, energy-efficient lighting, and water-saving initiatives. The company also integrates wireless internet infrastructure to enhance guest experience and adopts digital payment platforms to align with evolving consumer behaviors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are travelers from Northeast Asia (Japan, Korea), Southeast Asia (including Mainland China, Hong Kong), and North America. The company targets both leisure and business travelers, including international conference attendees, exhibition participants, and tourists. It also serves commercial tenants through its building leasing operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taipei, Taiwan, with its hotel located in the city center near major metro stations. It also has overseas investments in the United States. The customer base is international, with significant markets in Japan, Hong Kong, Korea, Mainland China, Southeast Asia, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the tourism and hospitality supply chain, providing accommodation, dining, and event hosting services. It sources supplies such as room amenities and food ingredients from upstream suppliers but focuses on service delivery to end consumers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding domestic and international tourism markets, enhancing service quality, and diversifying investments. The company plans to leverage government policies such as visa-free entry and tourism promotion programs. It emphasizes digital transformation by adopting online booking platforms, upgrading IT infrastructure, and integrating mobile payment systems. Sustainability initiatives focus on energy efficiency, waste reduction, and social responsibility training.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through rental income from commercial properties and hotel room sales. Additional income streams include dining services, event hosting, and other ancillary services. The company also recognizes income from equity-method investments in related domestic and international enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the Taipei tourism hotel market, leveraging its long history, central location, and moderate pricing to maintain competitiveness. It faces challenges from government-supported hotels with price caps and fluctuating tourist arrivals, especially from Mainland China. Its positioning emphasizes accessibility, cultural experience, and diversified dining options to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$355.88 million in the latest fiscal year, showing a 3.67% increase from the prior year. Pre-tax profit decreased by 8.34%, and net profit declined by 7.64%, partly due to reduced equity income from investments. Total assets are around NT$11.74 billion, with equity totaling about NT$10.18 billion, indicating a stable financial scale with moderate growth and profitability challenges amid pandemic impacts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its historic reputation, prime city-center location, and comprehensive service offerings including lodging, dining, and event spaces. It differentiates through mid-range pricing, diverse culinary options, and enhanced guest convenience such as wireless internet and multiple payment methods. Sustainability efforts and social responsibility initiatives further enhance its brand value and customer trust.
